title: A part sale is one Part Sales row holding the whole sale
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • {Location-A}'s Shop Supplies Charge is 0%, and nothing else is invoiced at {Location-A} today.
  • Part sale {Part-sale-1} for {Customer-A} has one part at $80.00 and shop supplies of $5.00, and its Sales Representative reads {Sales-rep-A}; part sale {Part-sale-2} has one part at $40.00, no shop supplies and Sales Representative {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Part-sale-1} is P-30001 and {Part-sale-2} is P-30002.
  • Starting screen: the Part Sales page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Invoice {Part-sale-1} and {Part-sale-2}.
  2. Open Reports > Sales By Representative, set the date range to today, turn Show Unassigned on and turn the Sales Type column on in the column selector.
  3. Read {Sales-rep-A}'s rows for the two part sales.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: both are invoiced.
  • Step 2: the report shows today's invoices.
  • Step 3: each part sale is one row with Sales Type "Part Sales" holding every dollar: {Part-sale-1} $80.00 of parts with Shop Supplies $5.00; {Part-sale-2} $40.00 with Shop Supplies showing a dash.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S5-R9, S5-R15a, S5-R3, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R9: “A part sale is one "Part Sales" row holding every dollar of the invoice.”
  • S5-R15a: “On a Part Sales row, Shop Supplies shows the part sale's shop supplies, or a dash when it has none.”
  • S5-R3: “The report reads every invoice as one row per representative per Sales Type: "Labor" for a work order's labor side, "Parts" for its parts side, and "Part Sales" for a part sale.”
